drafted_from: tool:listen-to-music-windows-against-a-film-brief row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Listen to the music excerpts in /work/music/out against the sections of my film brief and a reference stem." It runs the listener and reads each excerpt's mood match per section.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads BRIEF.json and the excerpts the window finder wrote on this computer and writes listen.json beside them.
instructions: 1. Run tool:find-music-windows-that-follow-a-loudness-arc first, so /work/music/out/music/windows.json and its excerpts exist.
2. Add to brief.json the film's sections [{name, start, end, query}], alts (opposite moods) and reference {stem, sections [[start, end], ...]}.

3. Say "Listen to the music windows". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 <earshot python> -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/listen_to_music_windows.py /work/music/brief.json /work/music/out

4. Read the last line, then open out/music/listen.json: per excerpt the per-section mood z, mean mood z, typicality against the reference, realness and top describe tags; the reference stem is cut into ref-sections/.

worked_examples.title: The excerpt at 19 s is judged against the section "calm low pad"
worked_examples.ask: Judge my music excerpts against my film's section words.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_the_window_that_follows_the_arc_wins_and_is_listened_to, stand-in earshot): brief.json adds sections [{"name": "open", "start": 0, "end": 5, "query": "calm low pad"}], alts ["rock"] and reference {"stem": "/work/music/track.wav", "sections": [[0, 5], [5, 10]]}; the excerpt is {track}@{19}.wav (the track name, @ and the start second, as find_music_windows.py names it). Command: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 python -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/listen_to_music_windows.py /work/music/brief.json /work/music/out
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"listen": "/work/music/out/music/listen.json"}}. listen.json[0] is track@19 with sections {"open": {"query": "calm low pad", "z": 2.86}}, mood_z_mean 2.86, typicality {"typical_z": 0.0}, realness_verdict "unsure", describe_summary "a tone near 220 Hz", lufs -18.4; ref-sections/ holds reference-section1_0-5.wav and reference-section2_5-10.wav.
